subject.title: Fix silent context-engine maintenance task delivery status

question: Should this internal message-delivery PR wait for real behavior proof, or may a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate based on source and regression-test evidence?
rationale: The patch appears correct from source review, but ClawSweeper's external-PR proof gate is unmet and the touched status field controls user-visible task delivery.

options.title: Require delivery-path proof
options.body: Wait for redacted live, terminal, or log proof covering fast silent completion plus long-running or failed maintenance promotion before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept source and focused test evidence for this internal task surface, while owning the remaining runtime-proof gap.
